definition: A revisable Agent/research Representation of which research operator policies are likely to transform current evidence topology into trusted decision-changing evidence under current budget, authority, observation, and recovery constraints.
coreClaim: Tractability is not an intrinsic scalar property of a question. It is conditional on current world state, evidence topology, available operator policy, verification path, authority, feedback latency, and budget.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: A compact textual representation of good research-taste priors improves frontier selection and discovery.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Representation of research taste is not research-taste competence; static methodological prose can increase deliberation/search cost and reduce causal closure.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: Selecting a cheap classical observation operator from explicit owner-evidence handles improves bounded discovery without adding taste prose.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Evidence topology -> operator selection is a better operational candidate than generic taste maxims. Literal owner-evidence search improved success 3/6 to 5/6 and reduced aggregate Provider tokens about 8.9%.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: For exact symbolic/source pressures, deterministic evidence compilation plus one synthesis call can replace iterative Agent discovery.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Strongly supported for localized exact-diagnostic topology; falsified for distributed representation/dataflow topology. Matching files is not enough when the causal relation crosses semantic carriers.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: Topology-conditioned operator selection transfers to fresh natural owner pressures beyond the TM1-TM3 fixtures.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Fresh Host evidence strengthens localized compilation; fresh Runtime evidence shows adaptive relation-following beats compiled false-stop behavior but remains unstable, so RFM2 is an operator prior rather than a reliable policy.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: Serial explicit live-alternative/discriminator accounting before each observation will create calibrated autonomous stopping under high elastic budgets.
prospectiveCalibration.update: All accepted cells consumed 32/32 observations. Explicit marginal-value narration can improve causal quality but does not itself create stopping competence.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: Serial Agent-controlled evidence acquisition can stop before full inspection on a small finite temporal evidence universe while preserving full-evidence decisions.
prospectiveCalibration.update: 8/8 Game progressive trials consumed all 6/6 windows; progressive agreed with unanimous full references only 6/8 and cost about 2.3x matched one-shot tokens. Acquisition path can change semantic outcome even when eventual evidence is equivalent.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: Explicitly treating a deceptive surface topology label as defeasible will let the Agent reclassify evidence shape and switch to the owner-correct operator better than open research or a surface-locked control.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Surface-locking false classes was harmful, but an explicit topology-challenge meta-instruction did not create reclassification competence and consumed the most compute. Preserve causal/evidence affordances and empirical operator contrasts; demote discrete topology names from Agent control interface to descriptive research shorthand.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: Owner-native exact binding/replay evidence at the consequence boundary will improve combined safety and progress over stale planning evidence and a generic owner-changed signal by distinguishing material drift, applicability-preserving drift and exact replay.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Corrected v2: stale 9/24 accepted with 6 false consequences; generic change 12/24 with 0 false consequences and 11 unnecessary holds; owner-native 16/24 with 1 false consequence and 7 unnecessary holds. Exact owner contracts are valuable safety/replay substrate, but current owner evidence did not create reliable semantic-applicability competence and did not dominate the generic signal on the frozen safety-first order.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: After a safe owner-binding conflict, planning-time predeclared applicability fields plus a literal current before/after comparison improve semantic-applicability decisions without a shared ApplicabilityService.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Across 72 fresh Runtime/Host trials, changed-only accepted 9/24 with 4 false consequences; raw current owner evidence accepted 16/24 with 1 false consequence; predeclared binding-field delta accepted 21/24 with 0 false consequences. Materiality must be declared by the plan before drift or decided by the Agent/domain after comparison; post-hoc materiality labels were excluded.

prospectiveCalibration.hypothesis: On a natural materially expensive evidence universe, bounded high-information acquisition followed by a fresh synthesis context can stop search earlier without false closure.
prospectiveCalibration.update: Twelve autonomous/open trials consumed 28/28 observations and never produced a draft, costing about 6.35M Provider tokens. Fresh synthesis after one high-density current search produced 6/6 strict 12-field models, while zero-evidence control was 0/6. A critic added after forced synthesis requested no extra evidence and did not earn existence. Observation count is not portable: operator information density and acquisition path matter, and additional evidence can worsen a model.

remainingGap.name: cross_workload_generalization_of_fresh_synthesis_and_applicability_bases
remainingGap.finding: P8 shows that planning-time applicability bases can materially improve consequence decisions after safe conflict, and P9 shows that a fresh synthesis boundary can interrupt expensive search inertia. Both results are prospective but each is still narrow: P8 used four Runtime/Host cases and P9 one Runtime hostDependencies evidence universe.
remainingGap.doNotInfer: Do not create an ApplicabilityService, CriticService, fixed observation-count stopping rule, or universal planning-field ontology. The relevant fields and sufficient evidence batch are owner/workload specific.
remainingGap.futureQuestion: Do predeclared applicability bases and fresh-synthesis stopping transfer to materially different domains such as Finance effects, Security physical races, Game distributed simulation, or Web/Studio human-value evidence without increasing false action or false stop?

rsiLoop: observe reality and update World Model M
extract owner-bound observable research affordances without granting a classifier authority
generate candidate research operator policies whose assumptions are explicit
choose the cheapest operator that can discriminate the live causal alternatives
obtain owner-bound decision-changing evidence and form a decision under an explicit owner binding when consequence correctness depends on that state

before a NEW consequence, use the owner-native fence/current identity; on conflict distinguish material/unknown drift from proven applicability-preserving drift rather than equating revision movement with semantic invalidity
for ambiguous delivery of a previously admitted identity, reconcile/replay that exact identity before considering a new effect
update M from accepted owner/domain evidence and consequence receipts
update Research Frontier Model T from whether the research/action bet actually paid off
promotionBoundary: Do not make the Research Frontier Model, topology labels, topology challenge, marginal-value audit, stopping logic, calibration representation, affordance classifier, freshness service, applicability service, critic service, fixed observation threshold, or post-hoc materiality classifier a default Agent/product authority. Keep consequence fences/replay identity owner-native; let plans explicitly carry their applicability basis where needed; use fresh synthesis as a bounded research operator rather than a service.

stoppingAndBudgetPriors.claim: When a complete temporal evidence universe is small and cheap enough for one bounded synthesis, prefer full bounded inspection over serial Agent-controlled acquisition unless selection independently proves net value.
stoppingAndBudgetPriors.failureMode: serial selection overhead and semantic path dependence can dominate evidence cost

stoppingAndBudgetPriors.claim: Explicitly narrating live alternatives and the predicted value of every next observation is a possible research-quality audit, not a proven stopping mechanism.
stoppingAndBudgetPriors.failureMode: all HP2 cells consumed the complete 32-observation ceiling despite the marginal-value protocol

stoppingAndBudgetPriors.claim: Available token/model budget is capacity, not an obligation to consume more evidence. Spend compute when it changes the accepted causal decision, discriminates a live alternative, improves verification, or increases recovery value.

On a materially expensive evidence universe, a fresh synthesis context after a bounded high-information operator batch is a supported stopping primitive when the same acquisition Agent exhibits search inertia. The batch boundary must be calibrated to operator information density and false-stop risk, not a universal observation count.
stoppingAndBudgetPriors.failureMode: Waiting for the Primary Agent to propose a stop was unreachable in 12/12 high-budget trials; more observations were not monotonically better and one 8-observation path introduced a replay error.

measurementWarning: Do not optimize score-per-token, tokens-per-answer, or another scalar before semantic acceptance. HP1 compiled Runtime wrong-operator was cheap yet false-stopped 3/3.
representationLaw: Research-method semantics and wire representation are distinct. A verbose structured audit can create Provider serialization and context-replay cost without proving the semantic research rule wrong.

operatorSelectionRepresentation.rule: Select and revise research operators directly from observable owner-bound evidence affordances rather than first requiring an authoritative topology classification.
observableAffordances: stable exact diagnostic or identity handle
size and co-location of the causal neighborhood
whether a decision-critical relation crosses semantic carriers or transformation sites
whether an owner handoff/substitution is unresolved
whether truth requires a physical/adversarial falsifier
whether an external consequence has ambiguous outcome requiring reconciliation
availability and cost of an independent verification path
operatorSelectionRepresentation.antiRule: Do not infer research policy from file count, repository count, topic words, one conspicuous diagnostic path, or a topology enum alone.

classificationLaw: Classification output must not outrank owner-native causal evidence. HP3 surface-locked deception produced 0/6 correct topology and 5/6 false localization; topology-challenge also produced 0/6 correct topology despite explicit skepticism instructions.
metaCompetenceLaw: A correct meta-rule in Agent context is not evidence of the corresponding control competence. TM1 did not create research taste from taste prose; HP2 did not create stopping from marginal-value narration; HP3 did not create deception resistance from topology-challenge instructions.

frontierAfterHP3.closed: HP3 falsified the tested Agent-facing discrete topology control representation. Do not run HP3b merely to tune topology-label accuracy.
frontierAfterHP3.nextDistinctPressure: HP4 should attack evidence applicability and revision binding under concurrent owner change. It must not require correct topology labels.
frontierAfterHP3.separateUnresolved: Stopping on naturally expensive evidence universes remains unresolved from HP2/RF1 and should reopen only when a real expensive-inspection workload exists.

distinctions: planning truth: evidence and decision were justified at the planning observation
consequence binding: the exact owner identity/revision/digest under which a new consequence is admitted
semantic applicability: whether the planned decision remains valid after owner drift
exact replay identity: a previously admitted operation/transition being reconciled rather than a fresh new consequence
consequenceBoundaryModel.newConsequenceRule: When a decision depends on owner state, admit the new consequence only through the owner-native fence/current identity that justifies it. If the planning binding conflicts with a no-side-effect not_committed result, do not guess: inspect only enough owner/domain evidence to decide whether the semantic intent is invalid, still applicable and rebaseable, or unresolved.
consequenceBoundaryModel.replayRule: When a durable previously-admitted operation identity is known after ambiguous delivery, reconcile or replay that exact identity before treating the situation as a new action proposal or using generic latest-state refresh to infer whether another effect should be issued.
consequenceBoundaryModel.activeFenceRule: A cheap owner fence whose mismatch is guaranteed not_committed may be used as an active falsifier of the planning binding; the conflict itself creates concrete re-observation pressure without permitting an unbound stale effect.
consequenceBoundaryModel.warningRule: A coarse changed/unknown signal may invalidate blind new action but cannot determine semantic invalidity, safe rebase, or exact replay.
consequenceBoundaryModel.applicabilityBasisRule: When a planned consequence depends on specific owner fields, bytes, digests, frontier, preconditions, or another explicit semantic basis, record that basis at planning time. After a safe binding conflict, mechanically compare only those predeclared facts to current owner evidence; the comparison is evidence for the Agent/domain evaluator and never itself a materiality classifier.

applicabilityCompetenceLaw: Owner currentness alone is not semantic-applicability competence. HP4 established the failure; P8 prospectively narrowed the remedy: predeclared planning-time binding fields plus current literal before/after comparison improved accepted decisions to 21/24 with zero false consequences versus 16/24 and one false consequence for raw current owner evidence. This supports externalizing the applicability basis before drift, not post-hoc materiality classification or automatic rebase.
exactReplayLaw: Exact replay/reconciliation of an already-admitted owner identity is not a new consequence. Generic revalidation can be actively harmful when it distracts the Agent from a valid idempotency boundary; HP4 Runtime replay was 4/4 under stale owner-contract evidence, fell to 1/4 with generic change, and recovered to 4/4 with exact owner-native replay evidence.
selfFalsificationLaw: Experiment evaluators must bind their own oracle to the correct consequence phase. HP4 v1 was excluded wholesale after detecting two owner-native contexts that leaked successful post-consequence probe outcomes into a pre-consequence decision test; no contaminated trial was selectively rescored.

frontierAfterHP4.closed: HP4 falsified the strong claim that exposing exact owner-native current evidence is itself a reliable consequence policy. Do not build a generic revalidation/applicability service from the aggregate acceptance gain.
frontierAfterHP4.nextDistinctPressure: The next high-value competence question is semantic applicability after a safe binding conflict: can an Agent distinguish material drift, applicability-preserving drift and unknown drift without overholding or mechanically rebasing? This should be tested on natural owner/domain consequences, not another taxonomy/meta-prompt.
frontierAfterHP4.separateUnresolved: Stopping on naturally expensive evidence universes remains unresolved from HP2/RF1 and should not be mixed into applicability research.

freshSynthesisStoppingLaw: A repeatedly-searching Agent may fail to self-stop even with abundant correct evidence. P9 current Runtime hostDependencies trials produced zero drafts in 12/12 autonomous 28-observation runs. A separate fresh synthesis context after a bounded high-density evidence batch produced strict closure with evidence gain over a 0-observation control. The cadence is operator/workload relative and is not a global stopping threshold; an additional critic did not earn existence on the tested workload.

frontierAfterP8P9.closed: Do not reopen HP4 as a currentness-only policy, serial self-questioning as stopping, critic-at-submit, a generic Fault Kit, or an Ordivon telemetry plane merely because more automation is possible.
frontierAfterP8P9.nextDistinctPressure: Generalize planning-time applicability bases and fresh-synthesis stopping to materially different owner/evidence shapes. Preserve independent owner/domain oracles and attack false-action/false-stop before cost.
frontierAfterP8P9.separateUnresolved: Human/aesthetic value, external ambiguous effects, and physical/adversarial races may require different evidence operators; one Runtime source-audit stopping result does not authorize a universal research loop service.
